content: What are you doing on Tuesday night? There's a great show at the Varsity Theater.
Tuesday night? Oh, sorry, I'm planning to finish my term paper. It has to be in on Wednesday morning.
Oh, well, never mind. Look, Wednesday, why don't we go out for dinner. We could go to that little restaurant you like so much.
That sounds like a great idea, but I think I might have to help my roommate clean the apartment. You see, we are having some people over on Thursday night, so we want the place to look really nice.
Well, that means you're going to be busy Wednesday night too?
Well, how about Friday night? There's going to be a basketball championship at school. How about we go and root for the old Blues?
Yes, I was planning to see that, but you know what's come up -- it's Daddy's birthday, so we are taking him out for dinner.
